extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: fun house (mirror maze) facade with porch, approx. 5.2 m wide, 5.1 m deep, 5.1 m tall
extras.notes: front faces -Y; lilac show facade with curvy crest, cream trim and a row of glowing bulbs, cream and pink striped hall behind it. Wooden porch with steps and railings; a cream and mint spiral striped rotating barrel ('fun-house_barrel', separate object, rotates around its long Y axis) rests on four steel rollers and leads into a dark arched doorway. Two big funhouse mirrors (wavy oval and hourglass) in gold frames with bulbs, striped awning, pictogram signs with spiral, star and heart. Mirror surfaces 'fun-house_mirror' and bulbs are not baked. No text, no faces, no figures

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
